maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.sourceTitle: Northern Inland Credit Union - Home loans product cards
maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.note: Each product card publishes its own LVR condition. Smart Home Loan (variable and 1/2/3 year fixed): "LVR 90% or below". Dream Home Loan variable P&I: "LVR 80% or below"; Dream Home Loan variable interest only: "LVR 90% or below". Value Home Loan: "LVR 80% or below". 90% is the highest LVR published on any product; NICU does not publish a policy maximum LVR. asAt is the page's HTTP Last-Modified date (11 May 2026) - the page carries no effective date.

notes.value: Published LVR conditions by product: Dream Home Loan variable P&I 5.99% p.a. - "LVR 80% or below"; Dream Home Loan variable interest only 6.44% p.a. - "LVR 90% or below"; Smart Home Loan (2 year fixed 6.39%, variable 7.44%, 1 year fixed 6.29%, 3 year fixed 6.59%) - "LVR 90% or below"; Value Home Loan (variable 5.94%, 1 year fixed 5.99%) - "LVR 80% or below". No LMI arrangement, LMI provider or above-90% option is published.

minLoanAmount.sourceTitle: Northern Inland Credit Union - Home loans product cards
minLoanAmount.note: The lowest published minimum is on the Dream Home Loan interest-only card: "Minimum $150,000 except when offers apply". Two discounted products carry a much higher minimum: Dream Home Loan variable P&I "Minimum loan amount - $500,000 (new mortgages only)" and Value Home Loan variable "New loans only, minimum loan $500,000". So $150,000 is the general floor and $500,000 is a condition of the two sharpest rates, not a policy minimum. asAt is the page's HTTP Last-Modified date.

notes.value: Northern Inland Credit Union is an independent member-owned mutual headquartered in Tamworth NSW, formed from the 1988 merger of Oxley Mutual Credit Union, Tamworth & District Community Credit Union and Namoi Credit Union. It has around 14,000 members and branches at Tamworth, Gunnedah and Narrabri plus a Newcastle office. MEMBERSHIP IS OPEN, NOT OCCUPATION-RESTRICTED: "Once you open an account or take out a loan with us you automatically become a Member." It remains independent - it has NOT merged with Regional Australia Bank (RAB's own merger history lists Peel Valley, Orana, Hunter Mutual, Holiday Coast, Macquarie Credit Union, Summerland Bank and a proposed SWSbank merger, but not NICU). NO BROKER CHANNEL WAS FOUND: nicu.com.au has no broker page, aggregator list, accreditation form or third-party lending guide.
notes.sourceTitle: Northern Inland Credit Union - About us

gaps: No broker channel could be found - no broker page, aggregator panel or accreditation process is published. NICU appears to be direct-to-member only.
No credit policy document, lending guide or serviceability calculator is published: nothing on assessment buffer, floor rate, DTI cap, rent shading, HEM or credit card assessment.
No policy maximum LVR is published - the 90% recorded here is the highest LVR appearing as a product-card condition, not a stated ceiling. Whether NICU lends above 90% with LMI is unknown.
LMI provider and LMI arrangements are not published.
No maximum loan amount and no maximum loan term is published (the comparison rate is illustrated on a 25 year term, which is not a maximum).
No income-type, employment tenure, credit-history, security/property or residency policy is published.
The home loans page carries no 'rates effective' date; asAt values are the page's HTTP Last-Modified date (11 May 2026).
NICU's ABN and Australian Credit Licence number were not captured from a public page in this pass.
